results.name: Constants
A full pod fires a burst of four, never closer than the gap, then a tap on the empty pod is dropped and says so
An empty slot regrows in six times the wave reload, one at a time (levels and endless)
A seed that touches a flower gives back half a seed; a miss gives nothing
A crown feeds the pod for itself and each flower it opens; a crack counts; a cup deflection does not, the first shell one a seed meets a little
A full pod takes nothing more, and a strike no seed earned (a test, the script) feeds nothing
A timely flight refunds a ringed bud once; a fresh aimed seed can earn the next ring
An old first ricochet still blooms and chains, but neither it nor its chain refills the pod
A timely crown keeps every chain refill after its seed has gone
A quick first hit does not let its late direct ricochets refill; stale or repeated shell glances feed nothing
A tap a blink early is kept and fires the moment the seed is ready, with the latest aim
An aimed shot let go a little before its seed regrows is kept for it; a quick tap that early is dropped
A kept tap that cannot fire in time says why instead of vanishing (five seeds went up meanwhile)
While a Super Bloom lasts nothing feeds the pod: a sun seed still flying when it ends feeds it like any other, a bought seed landing during one does not
Five seeds in the air still refuse a tap without keeping it or calling the pod dry
Super Bloom fires from the sun: no seeds spent, a seed every .22 s, no feeding, and the pod keeps regrowing
A Dandelion fans three seeds for one pod seed
The tutorial: setting the cooldown to zero hands over a full pod, early taps are simply dropped, the script earns nothing
The snapshot and the launch event carry the pod
Mashing with no aim, for these seeds: it costs lives on level 1, wins no more than one run in four of any later level, never cleanly, and mostly loses by wave 6
Rough aim at full speed, for these seeds: it nearly always loses levels 3, 4, 6 and 7, mostly 10, and its wins cost lives; levels 2, 5, 8 and 9 stay winnable that way about half the time
A fast, careful aimer clears every level, firing briskly (two runs a level; level 4 is the one it sometimes loses)
The suite runs in 40 seconds or less (the mashers play all ten levels)
